pr_title: backupccl: fix error when the restore rollback cleanup validates uncommitted schema descriptor
pr_body:
Previously, during a restore rollback, we only marked database as dropped to skip pre-txn validation when we drop all descriptors that we created at the start of the restore. This is not sufficient because we will also run validation against user-defined schemas.

This patch marked schema as dropped to skip validation too.

Fixes: #70049
Release note: none.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/70551)

issue_context.title: backup/restore: rollback does not clean up properly when UDTs and UDS are used together

review_comments: I think we should store to an immutable schema descriptor in this map. Even though it doesn't change the current behaviour it prevents us from unintentionally mutating the descriptor wherever we use the values in this map.
No worry in this case because what we are adding into `dbsWithDeletedSchemas` map is catalog.Descriptor which only has immutable APIs.
